hashConvention: Legacy beforeLockSha256/afterLockSha256 fields hash raw captured Windows working-copy bytes. core.autocrlf=true can produce CRLF working files and LF Git blobs; use normalized LF hashes to verify a fresh Git clone.

plugin-react 5.2.0 requires exact @rolldown/pluginutils 1.0.0-rc.3; replaces the old plugin 4.7.0 beta utility.
Use 5.2.0, the most recent release compatible with Vite 6; plugin 6 requires Vite 8. Its documented Fast Refresh minimum React 16.9 includes unchanged React 18.3.1.
electron-vite 6 requires cac ^7.0.0; the new CLI graph resolves 7.1.0.
Use current stable upstream electron-vite with declared Vite 6 compatibility; older branches have no demonstrated maintenance guarantee.

plugin-react 5.2.0 requires react-refresh ^0.18.0. React and react-dom application runtimes remain locked at 18.3.1.
